newsitem.title: USA: Tengasco will install plant in Tennessee.
newsitem.headline: Tengasco will install plant in Tennessee.

text.p: Tengasco Inc said Wednesday it has a contract to install a 60 megawatt co-generation plant at the east Tennessee site where the atomic bomb was developed.

The company has been named as a subcontractor to Operations Management International Inc, the company that won the contract to operate utilities at the site, it said. The value of the contract was not disclosed.

The project involves converting an existing steam-only plant to a one that produces both steam and electricity, the company said. It plans to double the initial capacity to 120 megawatts by the end of 1998.
